# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.shared.export_settings_reference` from `sidekick.shared.config.Settings`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Sidekick reads 68 environment variables, all prefixed `SIDEKICK_`. Set them in the process environment or in a `.env` file in the directory the backend is started from. The executable truth is the `Settings` class in [backend/src/sidekick/shared/config/](../../backend/src/sidekick/shared/config/); this page is rendered from it and a test fails when the two differ.

- An unknown `SIDEKICK_*` variable stops startup, so a misspelled name cannot leave a setting on its default.
- **Secret** `yes` means the value is kept out of `repr` and logs; it is never printed here. A secret can also be given as `<NAME>_FILE`, the path of a file that holds the value (for example `SIDEKICK_TOKEN_PEPPER_FILE`; a Docker secret). The file's trailing line break is dropped, and setting both `<NAME>` and `<NAME>_FILE` stops startup.
- Examples: [.env.example](../../.env.example) for local development, [selfhost.env.example](../../deploy/selfhost/selfhost.env.example) for a self-hosted instance.

## Core

Mode, database and the secrets every instance needs.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_ENVIRONMENT` | one of `development`, `test`, `production` | `development` | no | Deployment mode; production refuses to start with placeholder secrets. |
| `SIDEKICK_DATABASE_URL` | string | `postgresql+psycopg://sidekick_app:sidekick_app@localhost:5432/sidekick` | yes | SQLAlchemy URL of the application database; mandatory in production. |
| `SIDEKICK_CURSOR_SIGNING_SECRET` | string (at least 32 characters) | development placeholder, refused in production | yes | Secret that signs pagination cursors; must be configured in production. |
| `SIDEKICK_TOKEN_PEPPER` | string (at least 32 characters) | development placeholder, refused in production | yes | Pepper mixed into access-token hashes; must be configured in production. |

## Database time budgets

Limits on every application database connection. Migrations use their own connection.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | integer (min 1, max 120) | `10` | no | Seconds an application database connection may take to open. |
| `SIDEKICK_DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS` | integer (min 0, max 3,600,000) | `30,000` | no | Milliseconds a statement may run (0 = no limit); migrations are not bound. |
| `SIDEKICK_DB_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS` | integer (min 0, max 600,000) | `5000` | no | Milliseconds a statement may wait for a lock (0 = no limit). |
| `SIDEKICK_DB_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_MS` | integer (min 0, max 3,600,000) | `60,000` | no | Milliseconds a session may sit idle inside a transaction (0 = no limit). |

## Backups

Scheduled encrypted database backups.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | no | Turns on scheduled encrypted database backups; needs a key and a directory. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_DIRECTORY` | path | `.sidekick/backups` | no | Directory that holds the backups; must be absolute when backups are enabled. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` | secret string, optional | unset | yes | Key that encrypts backups; required when backups are enabled. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_RETENTION_COUNT` | integer (min 1, max 3,650) | `30` | no | Most finished backups kept before older ones go. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS` | integer (min 1, max 3,650) | `30` | no | Days a finished backup is kept before it is pruned. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_MIN_KEEP` | integer (min 1, max 3,650) | `5` | no | Newest finished backups that are never pruned, however old. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_SPACE_MARGIN_PCT` | integer (min 100, max 1,000) | `150` | no | Percent of the newest backup's size that must be free before a backup starts. |
| `SIDEKICK_BACKUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | integer (min 3,600, max 604,800) | `86,400` | no | Seconds between scheduled backups. |

## Derived memory

Memory derived from records and sent to Hindsight.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | no | Turns on derived memory; nothing is derived or sent to Hindsight while off. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_PROVIDER` | one of `fake`, `hindsight` | `fake` | no | Memory provider: in-process fake, or hindsight (needs URL, token, key). |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_INGEST_ENABLED` | boolean | `true` | no | Kill switch for sending: false stops every retain while recall keeps working. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_ORPHAN_SWEEP_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | no | Deletes Sidekick-format memory banks that no living user derives. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_HINDSIGHT_BASE_URL` | string | empty | no | Private base URL of the Hindsight server; required for hindsight. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_HINDSIGHT_API_TOKEN` | secret string, optional | unset | yes | API token for Hindsight; required when memory uses hindsight. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_ID_DERIVATION_KEY` | secret string, optional | unset | yes | Key from which per-user memory bank ids are derived; required for hindsight. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_HINDSIGHT_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES` | integer (min 1,024, max 16,777,216) | `1,048,576` | no | Largest Hindsight response body read after decompression; larger is refused. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_ALLOW_LOOPBACK` | boolean | `false` | no | Allows a loopback Hindsight address for a sandbox; refused in production. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_QUIET_SECONDS` | integer (min 600, max 86,400) | `600` | no | Quiet period after a change before a record is sent to memory (minimum 600). |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_DAILY_RETAIN_CAP` | integer (min 0, max 1,000) | `40` | no | Most records sent to memory per owner and day by live changes. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_BACKFILL_DAILY_CAP` | integer (min 0, max 5,000) | `150` | no | Most records sent to memory per owner and day by the backfill. |
| `SIDEKICK_MEMORY_DAILY_CHAR_CAP` | integer (min 0, max 10,000,000) | `400,000` | no | Characters sent to the memory provider per owner and day, live and backfill. |

## MCP server and sign-in

The public MCP server, its name, language and authentication.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_SERVER_NAME` | string | `Sidekick` | no | Name the public MCP server reports; Claude shows it as the connector name. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_APP_LOCALE` | one of `sv`, `en` | `sv` | no | Language of the Sidekick MCP Apps: sv (default) or en. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_STDIO_OWNER_ID` | string | empty | no | User UUID the local stdio entrance acts as; empty means it will not start. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_AUTH_MODE` | one of `pat`, `github_oauth` | `pat` | no | Public MCP authentication: personal access token, or GitHub OAuth sign-in. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | string | empty | no | Bare public origin (HTTPS) the outside world reaches this process on. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` | string | empty | no | Client id of the GitHub OAuth app; required for github_oauth. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` | secret string, optional | unset | yes | Client secret of the GitHub OAuth app; required for github_oauth. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_SIGNING_KEY` | secret string, optional | unset | yes | Key (32+ characters) that signs OAuth state; required for github_oauth. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_STORAGE_DIR` | path, optional | unset | no | Absolute directory for persisted OAuth state; required for github_oauth. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_IDENTITIES` | string | empty | no | Comma-separated `github:<numeric id>=<user uuid>`; anyone else is refused. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES` | string | empty | no | Comma-separated Sidekick scopes an OAuth session holds (MCP scopes only). |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECT_URIS` | string | `https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback` | no | Comma-separated OAuth callback URIs accepted (HTTPS, or loopback HTTP). |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_ENABLE_CIMD` | boolean | `false` | no | Accepts Client ID Metadata Documents, which make the server fetch a URL. |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_UPSTREAM_CACHE_SECONDS` | integer (min 0, max 3,600) | `300` | no | Seconds a successful GitHub token check is reused (0 = check every request). |
| `SIDEKICK_MCP_OAUTH_SESSION_DAYS` | integer (min 1, max 90) | `30` | no | Days a newly issued OAuth session lasts before the client must sign in again. |

## Companion app and push

The Android companion adapter and durable push delivery.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_COMPANION_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | no | Registers the companion adapter `/companion/v1/` for paired Android devices. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | string | `ntfy.sh` | no | Comma-separated DNS hosts allowed as push endpoints (SSRF guard), never IPs. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_AUTH_HOST` | string, optional | unset | no | Self-hosted ntfy host that receives the bearer token; must be allowed above. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_AUTH_TOKEN` | secret string, optional | unset | yes | Bearer token sent only to the push auth host; unset sends no credentials. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_ENABLED` | boolean | `false` | no | Turns on durable push delivery and the push worker (`sidekick-push-worker`). |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_POLL_SECONDS` | integer (min 1, max 300) | `5` | no | Seconds between the push worker's looks at the outbox. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_WAKE_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | integer (min 0, max 3,600) | `20` | no | Minimum seconds between wake pushes to one subscription (0 = off). |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_SUMMARY_TIME` | time of day (HH:MM) | `08:00` | no | Local time of the morning summary of tasks due today or overdue. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_DUE_LEAD_MINUTES` | integer (min 0, max 720) | `15` | no | Minutes before a task's clock time that its reminder is announced. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_QUIET_START` | time of day (HH:MM) | `21:00` | no | Local time the push quiet hours start. |
| `SIDEKICK_PUSH_QUIET_END` | time of day (HH:MM) | `07:00` | no | Local time the push quiet hours end. |

## Request limits

Protection of the public surface against slow and failing clients.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_BODY_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | number (above 0, max 300) | `30.0` | no | Seconds a public request body may take to arrive; slower gets 408. |
| `SIDEKICK_OAUTH_BODY_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | number (above 0, max 300) | `10.0` | no | Seconds an OAuth form body may take to arrive; slower gets 408. |
| `SIDEKICK_MAX_BUFFERED_REQUESTS` | integer (min 1, max 1,024) | `32` | no | Most request bodies (up to 1 MiB each) arriving at once; more gets 503. |
| `SIDEKICK_FAILED_AUTH_PER_CLIENT_PER_MINUTE` | integer (min 1, max 10,000) | `10` | no | Failed bearer attempts per minute from one address before further 429s. |
| `SIDEKICK_FAILED_AUTH_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE` | integer (min 1, max 100,000) | `60` | no | Failed bearer attempts per minute from all clients before further 429s. |
| `SIDEKICK_FAILED_AUTH_RESERVE_PER_MINUTE` | integer (min 0, max 1,000) | `5` | no | Unknown-token requests per minute that always get through (0 = no reserve). |

## Instance

Time zone, rooms, update reminder and build information.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_OWNER_TIMEZONE` | string | `Europe/Stockholm` | no | IANA time zone of the owner; the agenda's and journal's days count in it. |
| `SIDEKICK_ENABLED_ROOMS` | string | `work,journal,shopping,contacts,control` | no | Comma-separated rooms shown: work, journal, shopping, contacts, control. |
| `SIDEKICK_UPDATE_REMINDER_DAYS` | integer (min 0, max 3,650) | `14` | no | Days after which a calm update note shows, judged by code age (0 = off). |
| `SIDEKICK_BUILD_INFO_FILE` | string | empty | no | Path of the build-info JSON that tells the age of the running code. |
| `SIDEKICK_BUILD_COMMIT` | string | empty | no | Commit the running code was built from (baked in by Docker). |
| `SIDEKICK_BUILD_DATE` | string | empty | no | ISO 8601 build time with timezone (baked in by Docker). |

## License

The key that verifies the instance's licence.

| Variable | Type | Default | Secret | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SIDEKICK_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY` | string, optional | unset | no | Licensor's base64 Ed25519 public key; unset uses the built-in constant. |
